verdict.rationale: The M4 Pro is a chip, but the evidence shows it can be programmed through documented public developer APIs. Metal gives access to the GPU's capabilities and has a debugger, the Metal Performance Shaders Graph integrates Core ML models, Core ML and MLX run models on Apple silicon, and PyTorch backends support training. That is programmatic compute access through frameworks, not an API for directly driving or controlling the product, and the llms.txt probe returned a 404. Missing for 10: an API aimed at agent or automation control of the product, machine-readable docs for AI (llms.txt), and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.
